sloka: पृथिव्या सह वैदेह्या श्रिया च पुरुष ऋषभः ।क्षिप्रम् तिसृभिर् एताभिः सह रामः अभिषेक्ष्यते ॥२-४४-१७॥
transliteration: pṛthivyā saha vaidehyā śriyā ca puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ।kṣipram tisṛbhir etābhiḥ saha rāmaḥ abhiṣekṣyate ॥2-44-17॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, will soon be coronated with these three namely the earth, the goddess of fortune and Sita.
